title: HOW TO #1: Hide From the Police Underground
caption:
How to hide from the police underground 🚓🕳️

The police are 300 meters behind you. 10 problems, 10 fixes: a 2 meter hole, a stream to wash your scent, 5 meters deep against the heat camera, a clay wall that sounds like solid rock, 3 vents for the steam. End result: 6 tunnels, 12 meters deep, 300 meters long. Nobody finds you.

Which fix saved you: the stream, the clay wall or the air vents? Comment TUNNEL below. Tag the friend who would run first and ask questions later. Follow @StickMindR8 for HOW TO #2!
